entries.db7dedfb007f6ac6: With customer-first as the foundation of its management, the company sets as its basic policy contributing to realizing a richer and more peaceful society by giving "joy" and "satisfaction" to as many people as possible, through corporate activities based on "innovative" thinking. In its Medium-Term Management Plan 2026, with "maximizing group synergies" as the theme, it carries out business portfolio reform, and sets as its priority strategies the expansion of new sales channels and new sales (promoting "oshikatsu consumption" through events and the like), the full-scale start of the umbrella business, strengthening the EC business, and a digital strategy (strengthening SNS communication and promoting DX). As its approach by segment, in the personal items business it sets out strengthening licensed brands and originals, new items, and expanding EC sales, and in the fragrance business, a digital strategy and improving market share.
entries.df27ae0e3c64442e: Department stores account for 51.2% of sales channels, a majority, and the company is greatly affected by trends in the department store format. While inbound demand from the increase in the number of foreign visitors to Japan supports urban stores, the company is also affected by store closures and sales floor reductions at large GMS, and in personal consumption a cautious purchasing attitude toward mid- to high-priced products continues. As a weather factor, a warm winter affected sales of scarves and mufflers in their busy season.
